_about: SEASON (the owner's pick C, 20.10.2026; src/tcseason.js). A season runs September to August. Lanes: exhibitions, asking the clients of year Y for their Y+2 training plans (October to December), the year-end calendars & gifts. Ids never change once used; labels can.

plans._about: Ask for Y+2 plans: in October to December of the season's first year, every company that trained delegates in the year before the season (Y = start year - 1) is asked for its training plan for Y+2.

seed._about: The ONE seed from the Excel tabs (src/tcseason.js seedPreview / seedApply), an admin one-off like the TC import: the preview writes nothing and answers counts and a hash, the apply needs that hash and runs once. The Excel has no dates: the dates here are the build's, marked to confirm unless known; an admin changes them on the event's page.
seed.source: Planning of customers.xlsx (exhibition and calendar tabs)
